subject: english
question:
What is the meaning of the proverb

**"Don't count your chickens before they hatch"?**

options.text: Hatching eggs is an unpredictable process.
Don't assume success before it happens.
Chickens should be counted immediately after hatching.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Don't assume success before it happens."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The proverb **"Don't count your chickens before they hatch"** means that one should not make plans or assume outcomes based on events that haven't yet occurred. (अधूरे कार्यों पर पहले से ही परिणाम मान लेना गलत है।)

 
 
• **Example:** He was so confident about the deal that he bought a car before it was finalized, only to lose the deal later. Truly, "Don't count your chickens before they hatch."
